video_title: What Is Going On With Warriors & Kristaps Porzingis? We Explain

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' unusual handling of Kristaps Porzingis's contract and services
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors are not delivering payments to Kristaps Porzingis on his $20 million salary.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Warriors are not delivering payments to Kristaps Porzingis on his $20 million salary, ruling that he is not rendering services. Golden State is permitted to move his contract at any point before the February 11 deadline, even without paying him, and will continue exhausting trade avenues as the 31-year-old leans toward ending his NBA career. Absorbing Porzingis's near-expiring deal would allow a rival team to move a salary out and save money and clear a roster spot via a buyout.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The bizarre nature of Kristaps Porzingis's current career situation
quotes.excerpt: It's a bizarre situation. KP, who can still impact games in the NBA, obviously health's been an issue.
quotes.quote: It's a bizarre situation. KP, who can still impact games in the NBA, obviously health's been an issue for forever, but when he's on the floor he's still an effective player for the most part. And under contract for 20 million this year and basically just decides, you know what, I don't want to play. And yeah, I'm sure there's some kind of health issue he's dealing with, he's been dealing with the illness off and on for a while, but what a strange situation.

quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis's performance and injury history with the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: His post-up game was huge for the Celtics. Then he's hurt most of the playoffs.
quotes.quote: He was a big-time post-up weapon for them, which was, he was terrible as a post-up player in Dallas. There was a lot of things that butt heads with Rick and Luka about, but one was he wanted post touches and he was awful in the post at the time. His post-up game was huge for the Celtics. Then he's hurt most of the playoffs, and then he comes back and has this unbelievable performance in the Finals and then gets hurt again.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The confusion surrounding the Warriors' trade strategy for Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: Shams is like, they're not paying them, Porzingis is not fighting it, and they're still trying to trade him.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Shams is like, they're not paying them, Porzingis is not fighting it, and they're still trying to trade him. And I was listening to these two guys sitting behind me and they were like, what do you mean? I mean, this is the NBA. What do you mean they're trying to trade him? So wait a minute, he's not playing, we're not paying him, but we're trying to trade him?

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: Honestly, it actually increases his value in the trade market because now not only is it kind of a quasi-expiring contract, but you're going to get a discount because he'll take a buyout.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' challenge of remaining competitive during Steph Curry's twilight
quotes.excerpt: They're trying to be competitive during Steph's twilight, which Steph's still obviously lighting it up.
quotes.quote: They're trying to be competitive during Steph's twilight, which Steph's still obviously lighting it up. They're hoping to get Jimmy back, I don't know, mid-season, February-ish. Jaxon is, I mean, if we're going to go on like early awards discussions, certainly a Rookie of the Year candidate. My point is Jaxon is a big-time contributor right now right away and a bridge to the future. And so as you've got this kind of get-out-of-jail-free trade chip, you got to be careful because there's two ways you can cash it in: take back bad money or attach picks to it. And so I think you still have to be careful of doing too much now and putting yourself in a real bad situation later. I mean, the big wild card for the Warriors is Jimmy Butler.
